problem: If ${e}^{3x}=9,$ then $x≈${{field-1}}, rounded to $3$ decimal places.
worked_solution:
First, we take $ln$ of both sides of the equation and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{e}^{3x} & =9 \\ ln⁡({e}^{3x}) & =ln⁡(9) \\ 3x & =ln⁡(9) \\ x & =\frac{1}{3}ln⁡(9)\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating the above expression using a calculator gives

$$
x≈0.732
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
